principle: Identity linkage is the hardest technical and ethical problem; uncertainty must be represented, not hidden.

examples: agency personnel number if lawfully public
badge number plus department plus date range
same named officer in docket and department roster

confidence_bands.label: probable same person
confidence_bands.meaning: may show as tentative with clear warning; no punitive aggregation

confidence_bands.label: stable same person
confidence_bands.meaning: canonical merge allowed with source-backed identifiers

hard_rules: Different departments plus common name requires negative match search.
Badge numbers are department-specific and cannot travel without department/date context.
A merge must carry unmerge/rollback behavior.
Identity confidence is field-level and time-bound, not a permanent aura.
